name: Escape Room Muchi na Kanojo wa Kyou mo Kawareru
original_name: エスケープ・ルーム 無知な彼女は今日も買われる
source:
The protagonist and his girlfriend, Arisa, have just started dating.
Today is their first date, and it was supposed to be a fun day, but they
are suddenly kidnapped by someone... and when they wake up, they find themselves in a strange room.

"If you can't escape, you will have to live in that room for the rest of your life."

Together with three other men who have also been captured, they are locked in a closed facility with no exit.
There is only one condition to escape - win the game and earn points.
In this place, you can buy anything you want as long as you have points. Whether it
's a key to get out or someone else's ownership -

some do it to get out of this place quickly.
Some just do it to release their sexual desires. They
risk their desires in the game.

Will the two of them be able to escape from this place safely?

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1257276]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主角和他的女朋友亚里沙刚刚开始约会。
今天是他们第一次约会，本来应该是有趣的一天，但他们
突然被人绑架了……当他们醒来时，发现自己身处一个陌生的房间。

“如果你逃不掉，你就只能在那个房间里度过余生了。”

他们与另外三名同样被捕的男子一起被锁在一个没有出口的封闭设施中。
逃脱的条件只有一个——赢得比赛并获得积分。
在这个地方，只要有积分，你就可以买到任何你想要的东西。无论是
是出去的钥匙或者是别人的所有权-

有些人这样做是为了快速离开这个地方。
有些人这样做只是为了释放性欲。他们
在游戏中冒险他们的欲望。

两人能否顺利逃离此地呢？

[译自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1257276]Getchu[/url]]
